name: Word of Command
description:
You issue a spoken command to a creature with medium range, using a single word imbued with magical power. Roll Persuade vs Riddle against the creature. On a win, the creature must obey your command on its next turn, unless it has a WITS score of 10, doesn’t understand your language you're using or if following the command would cause it obvious harm. The GM determines how the target behaves.

Describe how you issue the command.
successes:
✨: You may issue a second one-word command that does not contradict your first command. On a win, the creature must also obey that command on its next turn.

🌞: The creature must obey the command(s) on 2 additional turns in addition to its next turn.
